rawContent: A few years ago I was driving home w my baby sister and a cop tried to pull me over so I pulled in my driveway cuz I was that close to home. It was the 1st time and I was so fucking terrified. My tongue started swelling up and I was shaking so bad. That is ptsd #BlackLivesMatter

I think I need to take a break since it’s night here. Everyone stay safe and healthy and please take a break from social media if you need to for your mental health because a lot of this stuff is honestly so triggering. I love all my beautiful black people #BlackLivesMatter

This is actually run by my friend from college who is a trans woman! They really care about these issues and have been making beautiful art of black trans ppl for years to raise awareness. Trust that if you decide to donate that it is being used for good!!!  #BlackLivesMatter

We did it! This is really making me so emotional because this is so important to me and many other black people all over the world!!! So glad to see so many people willing to help these very important causes!!! 💜💖💕
